Chhattisgarh State Eligibility Test SET Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Chhattisgarh Vyapam has released the notification for the Rajasthan State Eligibility Test (SET) Exam 2026. Online applying process for Rajasthan State Eligibility Test SET Online Form 2026 has started from 14 June 2026 & the candidates can apply till 31 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Rajasthan State Eligibility Test SET Online Form 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 23 July 2026
  • Last Date : 17 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 17 August 2026
  • Correction Date : 18-20 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 04 October 2026
  • Admit Card : 28 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General / Other State : Rs. 300/-
  • OBC Candidates : Rs. 250/-
  • SC, ST and PwBD Candidates : Rs. 200/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
